title: AI Coworker Inbox Triage
hints: Simulate event by event. The only times anything can change are arrivals and completions, so jump between them with a heap of finish times.
At each time: free the coworkers that finish now, add the arrivals, then walk the pending queue in (deadline, arrives, id) order.
Escalate only when even the fastest skilled coworker, starting right now, would miss the deadline. If one could make it but is busy, keep waiting.
